cases.subject: selection does not move the playhead
cases.given: a chord card is selected while the transport is paused at beat 0
cases.expected: bookmarks.selection changes; transport.playhead is byte-for-byte equal

cases.subject: playback does not change the selection
cases.given: playback advances across three chords with one card selected
cases.expected: bookmarks.selection is byte-for-byte equal; only the playhead advances

reachability.reason: Playback advancing the playhead needs the serialized transport. The studio transport reports status 'unavailable' with isAvailable false because X0/X1 are not wired to it, so no gesture can advance a playhead to observe the selection against.

cases.subject: preview does not change the selection
cases.given: a chord preview is auditioned from the card menu
cases.expected: bookmarks.selection, insertion, and range are all byte-for-byte equal

reachability.reason: Auditioning one chord from the card menu is a U2 preview control over the X0 engine. U1 declares no audition gesture, so there is nothing to invoke and no preview to hold the bookmarks steady across.

cases.subject: range does not change the selection
cases.given: an ordered range is set across four events
cases.expected: bookmarks.range changes; bookmarks.selection is byte-for-byte equal

cases.subject: selection does not move the insertion point
cases.given: a different chord card is selected
cases.expected: bookmarks.insertion is byte-for-byte equal

cases.subject: all four concepts are simultaneously distinct
cases.given: selection on event 2, insertion after event 5, range 3 through 7, playhead at beat 12
cases.expected: each concept is rendered with its own accessible name and none of the four values is derived from another

reachability.reason: The case states 'playhead at beat 12' as a precondition. No U1 operation may move the playhead — that is the law this case tests — and nothing else can until the transport is wired. The three-bookmark half is proven independently by U1-INT-005; the fourth value and the four-way rendered-name claim wait on X1.

cases.subject: the chart is one tab stop
cases.given: Tab moves into a chart holding twelve chord cards
cases.expected: exactly one card is tabbable; the remaining cards have tabindex -1

cases.subject: arrow order equals visual order
cases.given: ArrowRight is pressed repeatedly from the first card of section A
cases.expected: focus visits cards in document order across measure and section boundaries without skipping insertion targets' own stop

cases.subject: Home and End reach the section bounds
cases.given: Home then End is pressed inside section B
cases.expected: focus lands on the first then the last enabled card of section B

cases.subject: disabled cards keep order but are skipped
cases.given: a card is disabled while a command is in flight
cases.expected: the disabled card retains its ordinal and is not focused by arrow movement

cases.subject: focus survives reorder by stable identity
cases.given: the focused card is moved from position 3 to position 1
cases.expected: the same event id remains focused and selected at its new position

cases.subject: focus survives a view-mode toggle
cases.given: the chart switches from compact to teaching while a card is focused
cases.expected: the same event id remains focused; no command and no bookmark change

cases.subject: focus moves to the next event
cases.given: the focused middle event of a three-event measure is deleted
cases.expected: focus moves to the following event in the same measure

cases.subject: focus falls back to the previous event
cases.given: the focused last event of a measure is deleted
cases.expected: focus moves to the preceding event

cases.subject: focus falls back to the section insertion target
cases.given: the only event of the only measure is deleted
cases.expected: focus moves to the section insertion target, never to the document body

cases.subject: a short movement stays a tap
cases.given: a touch pointer moves 7 CSS pixels before release
cases.expected: no drag starts, preventDefault is never called, and the tap activates the card

cases.subject: the threshold starts a drag
cases.given: a pointer moves exactly 8 CSS pixels
cases.expected: the drag session starts and preventDefault applies from that move onward

cases.subject: scrolling is preserved below the threshold
cases.given: a vertical touch drag of 6 CSS pixels crosses a chord card
cases.expected: the page scrolls; no card is dragged and no command is dispatched

cases.subject: pointer cancel releases capture
cases.given: the browser cancels the pointer mid-drag
cases.expected: capture is released, transient listeners are removed, and no command is dispatched

cases.subject: unmount releases capture
cases.given: the dragged card is unmounted by an undo while the drag is active
cases.expected: capture is released and the transient listener count returns to zero

cases.subject: no primary action requires hover or drag
cases.given: the pointer is never used
cases.expected: every chart operation is reachable through the keyboard bindings or the More menu

cases.subject: mount installs the declared listeners
cases.given: a chart with twenty chord cards is mounted
cases.expected: each card owns exactly three static listeners and each insertion target owns exactly one

cases.subject: reorder does not multiply listeners
cases.given: ten move commands reorder the same twenty cards
cases.expected: the static listener totals are unchanged

cases.subject: repeated mutation does not multiply listeners
cases.given: one hundred insert and delete commands are applied
cases.expected: static listener totals track the rendered node counts exactly and never accumulate

cases.subject: a drag adds at most three transient listeners
cases.given: one drag session is active
cases.expected: exactly three transient listeners exist and at most one drag session is open

cases.subject: unmount removes every listener
cases.given: the chart region is unmounted
cases.expected: static and transient listener totals are zero

reachability.reason: StudioShell mounts ChartWorkspace unconditionally for the lifetime of the application, so the chart region never unmounts while the page lives. The row is a design constraint on that composition rather than a state a gesture can enter. The leak class it guards is covered by U1-INT-020, a card unmounted mid-drag, and U1-INT-023, per-card listener totals across ten reorders.

cases.subject: Select range exposes explicit boundary actions
cases.given: Select range is activated on a touch viewport
cases.expected: Set start, Set end, start and end beat fields, Done, and Cancel are all reachable without a drag

cases.subject: Set start uses the focused boundary
cases.given: a card is focused and Set start is activated
cases.expected: the range anchor becomes that card's leading boundary; the selection is unchanged

cases.subject: Set end uses the focused boundary
cases.given: a later card is focused and Set end is activated
cases.expected: the range focus becomes that card's trailing boundary

cases.subject: beat fields accept exact rational text
cases.given: the start beat field receives 5/2
cases.expected: the exact rational boundary is stored without decimal rounding

cases.subject: an unparsable beat field refuses
cases.given: the end beat field receives 5..2
cases.expected: the refusal is u1.range_boundary_invalid and the prior range is intact

cases.subject: unordered endpoints refuse
cases.given: Set end names a boundary earlier than the anchor in document order
cases.expected: the refusal is u1.range_endpoints_unordered and no intent is dispatched

cases.subject: Cancel restores the prior range
cases.given: boundaries were changed and Cancel is activated
cases.expected: bookmarks.range returns to its exact prior value and the mode closes

cases.subject: both views render identical musical facts
cases.given: the same measure is rendered compact and teaching
cases.expected: symbol, exact duration, measure fill, and completion are identical; teaching adds explanatory labels only

cases.subject: toggling never mutates the document
cases.given: the toggle is activated twice
cases.expected: no document command is dispatched and the revision is unchanged

cases.subject: toggling never mutates bookmarks
cases.given: the toggle is activated with a selection and a range set
cases.expected: selection, insertion, and range are byte-for-byte equal

cases.subject: chart and transport stay reachable at 320 CSS pixels
cases.given: the studio renders at 320x568 in compact mode
cases.expected: the chart region and every chord-card action remain operable; no primary action is hidden behind hover

cases.subject: chart and transport stay reachable at 390 CSS pixels
cases.given: the studio renders at 390x844 in compact mode
cases.expected: the chart region and every chord-card action remain operable; no primary action is hidden behind hover

cases.subject: chart and transport stay reachable at 768 CSS pixels
cases.given: the studio renders at 768x1024 in medium mode
cases.expected: the chart region and every chord-card action remain operable; no primary action is hidden behind hover

cases.subject: chart and transport stay reachable at 1280 CSS pixels
cases.given: the studio renders at 1280x800 in wide mode
cases.expected: the chart region and every chord-card action remain operable; no primary action is hidden behind hover

cases.subject: chart and transport stay reachable at 1440 CSS pixels
cases.given: the studio renders at 1440x900 in wide mode
cases.expected: the chart region and every chord-card action remain operable; no primary action is hidden behind hover

cases.subject: an empty chart states its next action
cases.given: the document has one empty measure and no events
cases.expected: the chart shows the empty state with a named insertion target and the quick-entry field remains operable

cases.subject: token errors are individually visible
cases.given: the draft holds two valid and one invalid token
cases.expected: each invalid token keeps its source text and shows its own T0 code and range

cases.subject: an application refusal is shown verbatim
cases.given: A0 refuses a dispatched command
cases.expected: the refusal code and path are shown without translation and no retry occurs

cases.subject: an empty selection states its requirement
cases.given: no chord card is selected
cases.expected: selection-scoped actions are disabled with a named reason rather than silently inert

cases.subject: an overfilled measure states exact beats
cases.given: a duration edit would exceed the bar capacity
cases.expected: the notice reports the exact current fill, the exact resulting fill, and the capacity as rationals

cases.subject: an underfilled measure states its reason
cases.given: an explicit incomplete measure is confirmed
cases.expected: the stored reason is displayed with the measure and never invented

cases.subject: an inline edit cancels cleanly
cases.given: Escape is pressed with a dirty symbol draft
cases.expected: the exact prior source text is restored and nothing is dispatched

cases.subject: a completion dialog cancels cleanly
cases.given: Cancel is chosen in the incomplete-measure dialog
cases.expected: no command is dispatched and the duration editor keeps its draft

cases.subject: quick entry cancels cleanly
cases.given: Escape is pressed in the draft field
cases.expected: the draft clears to idle through one ephemeral intent and no document command is dispatched

cases.subject: a stale gesture never reaches A0
cases.given: the captured revision no longer equals the application revision
cases.expected: the gesture never reaches A0: publication clears the pending draft, so a draft carrying a stale captured revision cannot exist to be dispatched, and activating Insert anyway is a U1 pre-dispatch refusal

cases.subject: A0 repairs bookmarks after an out-of-band change
cases.given: another command deletes the selected event
cases.expected: the surface renders the repaired bookmarks and the requested focus target without inventing its own

cases.subject: array-position keys are a contract violation
cases.given: a counterfactual chart keyed by array position is reordered
cases.expected: focus and selection follow the position instead of the event id, which is exactly the confirmed legacy failure this package must make impossible
cases.note: Recorded as a refused counterfactual so the reorder proof cannot pass by accident.

cases.subject: the focused card is removed out of band
cases.given: another command deletes the focused event while the chart is focused
cases.expected: roving focus follows the declared repair order and never resets to the first card by position

cases.subject: arrow movement never leaves the chart region
cases.given: ArrowRight is pressed on the last enabled card with wrapping disabled
cases.expected: focus stays on the last card; movement is consumed and no command is dispatched

cases.subject: a pointer-only operation is a contract violation
cases.given: a counterfactual card action reachable only by dragging
cases.expected: no inventory row may declare a pointerAlternative of none; the specification refuses such a row

cases.subject: a committed command shows no refusal
cases.given: A0 accepts a dispatched command and returns a receipt
cases.expected: the refusal region stays empty and the announced result names the committed operation

cases.subject: the teaching view never introduces a musical fact
cases.given: a measure with no Roman label is rendered in teaching view
cases.expected: teaching adds explanatory labels only; absent analysis is shown as absent and never invented
